notes: Estimates (dims_confidence medium): length 3054 mm, width 1397 mm, height 1346 mm, wheelbase 2032 mm (the 80-inch figure is the one I am sure of) and tyre overall diameter 480 mm for a 5.20-10 crossply are from memory of period specs, not a checked sheet; track figures front 1220 mm and rear 1180 mm are the roughest numbers here and the least important, since only the wheelbase and tyre size show in the side view. Axle positions follow from front overhang about 550 mm and rear overhang about 470 mm, both estimates. Most important proportions: the wheels sit almost at the corners with tiny overhangs, the body is a tall rounded box (44.1 units high on a 100-unit length), the bonnet is long and nearly flat, the windscreen is upright, the roof is flat over the cabin, and the tail is a short, steep rear window over a stubby boot.
